narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Any rectangle can be cut into two identical squares, so the leftover piece is a square too.
<bookmark mark='measure'/>Measure the leftover piece. Its sides are one and a half centimetres and two and a half centimetres.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The two sides differ, so the leftover piece is not a square.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Two squares need a length twice the breadth, and three squares need three times the breadth.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. A rectangle is fourteen centimetres long and six centimetres wide.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Can it split into two identical squares?
